I couldn't open the Spaces list. The app is on the "All chats" screen, and the Spaces button is the grid icon with the red "20" badge in the bottom-left corner, at about x=60, y=1865 in the screenshot.

I have no way to send a tap to the simulator here. `simctl` can capture the screen and launch or open URLs, but it can't touch the screen. The task says host mouse and keyboard events are unavailable, so I didn't try the `cliclick` binary I found in the shims directory. The app doesn't have a known deep link for Spaces, so I didn't try `openurl` either.

To finish, someone needs to tap the grid icon at the bottom-left of the Element app. Alternatively, I can keep trying other automation paths if you can provide a tap mechanism. The screenshot is at `/private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/bench-shot1.png`.
